supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:53 UTC, the domain controller recorded cole.price being added to Remote Desktop Users by dev.sharma. The supplied environment context says membership of this group is restricted to IT, while cole.price is a vet tech.

About one minute after the group change, Explorer on cole.price's workstation updated a UserAssist entry whose ROT13-encoded path decodes to C:\Windows\System32\mstsc.exe. This is consistent with Cole launching Remote Desktop shortly after gaining membership, but does not establish a connection or its destination.
The group-change event identifies dev.sharma as the actor; a preceding domain-controller network logon for dev.sharma has the same logon ID as the group-change event.

At approximately the same time, dev.sharma initiated an RDP session to FILE-RB-01 from WS-DSHARMA-01, the designated workstation for server administration. This is consistent with the stated IT practice, but does not explain the addition of cole.price to Remote Desktop Users.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-RB-01 were not collected from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC due to an outage. This gap does not directly cover the directory group-change event, but limits review of activity involving that proxy during the window.
The supplied records do not show whether cole.price established an RDP connection after the group change.
claims_not_established: The available records do not establish the actor's motive or whether the group change was an intentional compromise rather than an unauthorized mistake.
No ticket or change-approval record was provided to confirm whether the group change was authorized.
The UserAssist entry does not establish the destination of any mstsc session or whether a remote logon succeeded.
additional_evidence_needed: Check the change-management and help-desk records for approval covering cole.price's addition to Remote Desktop Users.
Review domain-controller directory and security audit records for subsequent membership changes and related account activity.
Review endpoint and network telemetry for RDP connections from WS-CPRICE-01 after 13:42:53 UTC, and check destination servers for successful logons by cole.price.
If no valid authorization is found, remove the unauthorized membership and investigate the actor and affected systems.
unrelated_findings: dev.sharma launched OpenSSH to connect to PROXY-RB-01 on port 22; the supplied inventory says no remote-access tools other than approved services are approved. This is a separate finding and does not determine the group-change alert. (S27-00004, S27-00007)
A second OpenSSH connection from WS-DSHARMA-01 to PROXY-RB-01 occurred later in the review window. This is also separate from the alerted directory change. (S27-00066, S27-00069)
